title: LTO to issue order revoking driver's licenses over pedestrian lane incidents
summary: The Land Transportation Office on Wednesday said it is drafting a memorandum order that could lead to the revocation of the driver"s license of motorists involved in pedestrian lane-related incidents.

blocks.text: Photo from Land Transportation Office's Facebook page

The Land Transportation Office (LTO) on Wednesday said it is drafting a memorandum order that could lead to the revocation of the driver’s license of motorists involved in pedestrian lane-related incidents.
LTO chief Assistant Secretary Markus Lacanilao told GMA News that the move stemmed from numerous incidents in which pedestrians died while crossing the designated lanes.
Motorists were also caught on video failing to slow down or yield to pedestrians, according to the LTO. —with a report from EJ Gomez/Joviland Rita/KG, GMA News
